items.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) output
items.reason: The original feature thread explicitly discussed registry-distribution hashes, identified distribution external references as the likely representation, and deliberately deferred them from the initial exporter.

items.title: Add SBOM export support
items.reason: This implemented CycloneDX 1.5 export and closed astral-sh/uv#6012. The resulting implementation leaves hashes and external references absent and does not receive the export hash setting.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using literal terms including cyclonedx1.5, CycloneDX hash/hashes, component hashes, externalReferences, --hashes, and --no-hashes, plus conceptual terms covering SBOM verification, artifact/distribution checksums, and lockfile hash export. No dedicated prior tracker or active pull request was found. astral-sh/uv#6944, astral-sh/uv#9225, astral-sh/uv#10987, and astral-sh/uv#7064 were inspected but ruled out because they concern requirements.txt behavior or hashes absent from uv.lock for --find-links.

type_reason: This is a known scope limitation rather than a regression. astral-sh/uv#6012 agreed that distribution hashes were reasonable but explicitly deferred them from astral-sh/uv#16523. Adding them and making the hash-control option meaningful for CycloneDX introduces functionality the exporter has never provided.
summary: astral-sh/uv#21122 is the deferred hash follow-up from astral-sh/uv#6012 after astral-sh/uv#16523 shipped the initial CycloneDX exporter without distribution hashes; no issue or pull request already tracks it.
draft_response: Thanks for the detailed reproduction. Distribution hashes were discussed in astral-sh/uv#6012 and intentionally deferred from the initial CycloneDX implementation in astral-sh/uv#16523, so this is a valid scoped enhancement rather than a regression. The current exporter does not consume the hash setting and emits neither component hashes nor distribution external references. The next step is to settle the artifact representation—astral-sh/uv#6012 identified distribution external references as the likely fit—and add coverage for hashes being included by default and suppressed by --no-hashes.
